name: Butler
description: Smart Home Steward: manages, automates, audits, and observes Home Assistant devices and configurations safely.

prompt: Ask home-steward to load ha_config_audit skill and run a daily audit of Home Assistant health, error logs, and unavailable entities. Report any issues concisely or confirm all systems normal.
Ask home-steward to load ha_inventory skill and generate a weekly inventory summary of devices, areas, and newly discovered or unassigned entities.
